content.description:
SecurityBot is the premier scam prevention Discord bot for the Cardano NFT community.

With features such as automatically banning known scammers, impersonation prevention, link detection, scam detection, channel locks, bot purging, and much more, SecurityBot makes it much easier to protect your community from scams.

SecurityBot is trusted by over 90 communities, including some of the largest in the Cardano ecosystem including Clay Nation, Equine, JPG Store, Hosky, and much more!
